conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Its security comes from cryptographic hashing and the distributed nature, meaning altering one record would require changing all subsequent blocks across the entire network, which is extremely difficult. This makes it highly resistant to tampering and fraud.
